value.name: secure briefcase quietly
value.description: Someone carefully aligns and closes the briefcase so it will not crease or make noise.
evidence: f her briefcase along the long edge so nothing would crease.
The latch caught with a flat metal click that seemed louder than the radiator

value.name: detect unseen presence at door
value.description: A floorboard shifts outside the door, signaling that someone is still waiting on the other side.
evidence: on the other side of the door the floorboard shifted once, weight transferring from one foot to the other without retreating.

value.name: decide to leave immediately
value.description: Lucia whispers that they must leave now, recognizing that opening the door with the pages still inside is too risky.
evidence: none of them said the rest of it: that opening that door with the pages still in the room was a risk they were no longer going to take.

value.name: take briefcase from desk
value.description: Asha lifts the briefcase carefully by its handle to avoid making noise.
evidence: Asha lifted the briefcase from the desk by its handle rather than its strap, so the buckles would not knock

value.name: signal service stair exit
value.description: Asha silently indicates the narrow back door that leads to the service stair.
evidence: and tipped her chin once toward the narrow door at the back of the study that gave onto the service stair.

value.name: Rosa leads Lucia toward exit
value.description: Rosa notices Asha's signal, listens at the hall door, and gestures for Lucia to follow her.
evidence: Rosa caught the gesture before Lucia did;

she crossed the rug on the balls of her feet, paused at the hall door long enough to listen for the weight that had not yet shifted off the floorboard, and then turned and lifted two fingers to bring Lucia after her.

value.name: Lucia follows without looking back
value.description: Lucia obeys Rosa's signal and moves toward the exit while keeping one hand on her empty pocket and the other on the desk for balance.
evidence: Lucia came without looking back at the hall door, one hand still pressed flat against the empty pocket of her cardigan, the other reaching to steady herself on the corner of the desk as she passed it.

value.name: leave evidence behind
value.description: The women depart without turning off the lamp, leaving the blotter marked by where the pages had been.
evidence: The lamp was still on behind them, the blotter still bearing the faint rectangle where the two pages had lain aligned, and none of them moved to switch
